title: Nino Saint James returns stronger with new single "Go So Hard"
htmlContent: Nino Saint James is back after a 6-year hiatus with "Go So Hard." This is a comeback and an assertion of resilience and ambition and raw feeling. "Go So Hard" thrusts you into Nino's universe of a richly textured canvas of hardship, perseverance, and earned insight. His trademark mix of anguish and resolve echoes throughout the track, as personal struggles became a universal anthem for anyone desperate to rise again. https://youtu.be/7a_8cMqkC_k "Go So Hard" is a song and a statement. Every word, every beat vibrates with the authority of an artist who lived through the struggle and came out tougher. It's his new single, and the release couldn't come at a better time in what is set to be an epic year for Nino, who, you'll see, stands on the point of being heard. The single is a bridge between the artist he once was and who he's becoming-a freer version of himself that has no problem facing games/head on. For fans new and old, "Go So Hard" is an invitation to see a comeback in progress, a primal and undeniable reminder of the potency of overcoming odds with ambition and relentless self-confidence. Nino Saint James is not only back, but he's better, bolder, and going harder than ever. https://open.spotify.com/track/71jhhDULIOGZivg51sqmFX Follow Nino Saint James on Facebook, Instagram
